clue.text: Saving more, but still row about end-of-month gap

indicators.note: the row word sits around the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats

indicators.note: end-of picks the final letter of the word month

parts.note: a rift is a gap or split

explanation.surface: Someone economising harder still rows over a shortfall at the end of each month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts H (the last letter of 'month') plus RIFT inside TIER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone more thrifty is more careful with money, so saving more.

clue.text: Isn't commonly placed in tricky situation? That's good!

indicators.note: placed in says one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: sly means crafty or tricky
ain't is the colloquial, common form of isn't

explanation.surface: Someone praises a person who stays honest when caught in an awkward spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'placed in' puts AINT inside SLY; 'situation' and 'That's' only pad the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A saintly person is virtuous, so good in the moral sense.

clue.text: Beating the endless pilfering

indicators.note: endless says the word the loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written
pilfering is robbing, stealing

explanation.surface: A complaint about thrashing someone over constant petty theft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts THE to TH before ROBBING.
explanation.definitionFit: A throbbing heart is one that is beating, pulsing strongly.

clue.text: Restrained anger and then scoffed

parts.note: temper means anger, as in losing one's temper
to scoff food is to eat it greedily, so scoffed gives ate

explanation.surface: Someone lost their temper and then gobbled down a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A temperate person is moderate and self-controlled, so restrained.

clue.text: Useless wood exhibited in a trial

indicators.note: exhibited in says one piece is shown within the other

parts.note: a try is a trial or attempt
ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: A piece of worthless timber is shown as evidence in a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhibited in' puts ASH inside TRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Trashy goods are rubbish, worthless and so useless.

clue.text: The caricaturist from Port Said

indicators.note: from signals that the answer is made out of these letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A cartoonist hails from the Egyptian port city of Port Said.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' tells you the letters of PORT SAID are reworked.
explanation.definitionFit: A parodist mimics and exaggerates others, much as a caricaturist does in drawing.

clue.text: Sound serving man occasioning a certain animosity

indicators.note: Sound at the start tells you the word is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: a ranker is a soldier serving in the ranks, a serving man

explanation.surface: A servant with a rough voice provokes ill feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: A RANKER is a private soldier; said aloud it matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, lasting resentment, a kind of animosity.

clue.text: Attic hero putting an article to varied uses

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: varied says the letters of uses are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Greek hero finds different uses for a word like 'the'.
explanation.walkthrough: Attic means of Attica, the region of Athens; 'varied' rearranges USES to SEUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Theseus, slayer of the Minotaur, was the legendary hero-king of Athens in Attica.

clue.text: Erica's man heart-broken

parts.note: he stands for a man

indicators.note: broken says the letters of heart are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Erica has a partner whose heart she broke.
explanation.walkthrough: Erica is not a woman but the botanical genus of the plant; 'broken' turns HEART into ATHER after HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the Latin genus name for the moorland plant also called ling or heath.

clue.text: The old washerwoman's means of putting on the squeeze

definitions.text: The old washerwoman's means of putting on the squeeze

parts.words: The old washerwoman's means of putting on the squeeze
parts.note: describes the hand-cranked rollers a laundress once used to press water out of washing, read as if about applying pressure

explanation.surface: A laundress of yesteryear had her own way of exerting pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: A mangle with rollers squeezed water out of laundry, which is what this device does.

clue.text: Fiery genius getting upset about nothing

indicators.note: about says the rearranged letters go round the other piece
upset says the letters of genius are knocked into a new order

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A brilliant person loses their temper over nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges GENIUS to IGNEUS, and 'about' puts it round O.
explanation.definitionFit: Igneous rock forms from molten magma, so it is of fire, fiery.

clue.text: Had outside right figure on the outside of a book

indicators.note: outside says the first word goes round the next

parts.note: taken as written
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a figure
over can mean on, as a cloth over or on a table

explanation.surface: Someone's right figure is pictured on a book jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts R inside HAD to make HARD; C is a hundred in Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff board binding forms the exterior of a book, its hard binding.

clue.text: A clerk can get credit

parts.note: a scribe is a clerk or copyist

explanation.surface: A humble office clerk is able to earn some recognition.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascribe something to someone is to attribute or credit it to them.

clue.text: It's difficult to believe youngsters produce such furniture

parts.note: a tall story is one hard to believe, so tall
boys are youngsters

explanation.surface: Remarkably, children turn out pieces of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: A tallboy is a tall chest of drawers, often in two stacked parts.
explanation.definitionFit: A tallboy is a high chest of drawers, an item of bedroom furniture.

clue.text: Finding the way about sea-going craft causes some anxiety

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
re means about or concerning
SS is steamship, a sea-going craft

explanation.surface: Navigating round ocean vessels makes someone nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress is mental strain or pressure, a form of anxiety.

clue.text: A four-letter word familiar to geometricians!

definitions.meaning: a word of four letters, such as the Hebrew name of God written with four letters
in geometry the term names a figure with four sides or angles, a quadrilateral

explanation.definitionFit: Tetra- means four and -gram something written or drawn: a four-letter word, or a four-sided figure.

clue.text: Mum, appallingly treated, is devastated

parts.note: mum as in keep mum means be quiet, signalled by sh

indicators.note: appallingly says the letters of treated are badly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A mother who was dreadfully treated is left heartbroken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' is not mother but the call for silence, SH; 'appallingly' turns TREATED into ATTERED.
explanation.definitionFit: Shattered means utterly upset, crushed, devastated.

clue.text: Set forth, but rushed back with speed

indicators.note: back says the word for rushed is read backwards

parts.note: ran means rushed
rate is speed, as in rate of knots

explanation.surface: Someone set off but hurried back home at a fast pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns RAN into NAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To set forth a story is to recount or tell it, which is to narrate.

clue.text: Dear old things!

parts.note: reads like an affectionate greeting to elderly friends, but means costly items of great age

explanation.surface: An affectionate hello to beloved elderly people.
explanation.definitionFit: Antiques are old objects, often expensive, so dear in price as well as cherished.

clue.text: Turn over a note to autograph

parts.note: re is a note in the sol-fa scale
to sign is to autograph

explanation.surface: Someone flips a page of music to add their signature.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign something is to hand or turn it over to another.

clue.text: Given direction, got out of bed about four — so wearing

parts.note: E for east is a compass direction

indicators.note: about says the word for got up goes round the other piece

parts.note: rose means got up out of bed
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Told where to go, someone got up at about four and found it tiring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts IV inside ROSE, with E in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Something erosive gradually wears material away, so wearing in that sense.

clue.text: The whole unit is awfully green, it would appear

indicators.note: awfully says the letters are put together badly, rearranged

explanation.surface: An entire department seems dreadfully inexperienced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' rearranges GREEN and IT; 'is' and 'would appear' just link.
explanation.definitionFit: An integer is a whole number, one made up of complete units.

clue.text: A spiritless fellow, way out and dull

parts.note: a door is a way out
mat or matt describes a dull, non-glossy finish

explanation.surface: A listless man is unconventional and boring.
explanation.definitionFit: A doormat is a person who lets others walk all over them, lacking spirit.

clue.text: Warrants speculators brought to light

parts.note: bears are stock-market speculators who bet on falling prices
out means revealed, brought to light

explanation.surface: Share certificates held by market dealers are made public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Warrants' looks like a financial noun beside 'speculators' but is the verb meaning confirms.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear out a claim is to confirm or support it, as evidence warrants it.

clue.text: The underworld before turning under

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

indicators.note: turning says the word for under is read backwards

parts.note: sub means under

explanation.surface: Hell is reached before one turns down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes SUB into BUS.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Erebus is the dark region of the underworld.

clue.text: This will hold for certain — no wobbling

indicators.note: wobbling says the letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Something guaranteed to stay firm with no shaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wobbling' rearranges CERTAIN plus NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A container is a box or vessel whose purpose is to hold things.

clue.text: Overeat, so take a little ginseng or get obese

indicators.note: take a little says to pick out a short run from the words that follow

explanation.surface: Advice on taking a small amount of a herbal remedy or else growing fat.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through 'ginsENG OR GEt'; 'so' and 'obese' fill out the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To engorge is to gorge oneself, eating to excess.

clue.text: Giving a top man the prize would be a bloomer

parts.note: a king is the man at the top
a cup is a trophy, a prize

explanation.surface: Handing a monarch a trophy would be a gaffe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder but means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The kingcup is the marsh marigold, a plant that blooms with yellow flowers.

clue.text: A Parisienne occupied by a struggle in the dark

indicators.note: occupied by says the first word holds the next pieces inside it

parts.note: une is French for a, in its feminine form as a Parisian woman would use it
taken as written
war is a struggle

explanation.surface: A Parisian woman finds herself caught up in a fight at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occupied by' puts A WAR inside UNE, the French feminine 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: To be kept in the dark is to be ignorant of something, uninformed.

clue.text: Pays for changes

definitions.meaning: makes amends for or puts right a wrong
puts on new clothes again, dresses once more

explanation.definitionFit: Redress means compensation or remedy; read as re-dress it means clothe again, a change of outfit.
